Verbatim copy of SKSEMenuFramework.h from
https://github.com/QTR-Modding/SKSE-Menu-Framework-3-API
commit 1dcb70179076aae4ab626f43c5baab2735ca5877 (2026-08-29).
The API repository carries LGPL-2.1; its license is preserved in
../../licenses/SKSE-Menu-Framework-API.txt. The separately installed framework
DLL retains its own terms. The recorded runtime baseline remains 3.13.0,
pending in-game acceptance; the API source revision is a separate pin.
The header resolves every function through GetProcAddress at runtime.
The inline wrapper is compiled into the plugin. See ../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
for the API license and ImGui/cimgui attribution.

nlohmann/json.hpp is the single-header release v3.12.0 from
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/download/v3.12.0/json.hpp (MIT).
Vendored rather than fetched so the native test build (ctest --preset native)
needs no network fetch for JSON. Embedded component notices and license texts
are recorded in ../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and ../../licenses/.
